hypotheses.subject: Euro-area energy-sensitive industry
hypotheses.condition: October flash energy inflation 20.8% and September industrial production -1.5% y/y
hypotheses.mechanism: Persistently high input prices could compress operating margins, but realized firm-level costs and contracts are not observed.
hypotheses.trigger: Verified electricity/gas delivered prices and industrial margins or output by sector
hypotheses.invalidation: Energy cost pass-through absent or offset by productivity gains

hypotheses.subject: Brazilian investment financing

hypotheses.mechanism: Higher expected rates may raise financing hurdles if realized lending terms follow
